notes: North-up sheet. Printed names: E. McMILLAN, SALUTARIS AV., INGLESIDE PL., HACKBERRY ST., CARONDOLET, BROOKLYN, ROSE ALLEY, COLUMBIA AV.; 'Street' added to McMillan, Carondolet and Brooklyn as on sheets 325-327. McMillan: only its south line runs the full width; its north line is drawn only from x~2200 eastward, so the Salutaris and Ingleside points use south line - 30 ft (60' printed) with the 10 in. pipe as a check (+/-20 px). Moorman: a ~50 ft opening in McMillan's north line at x~3140-3440 with a pipe stub, name NOT printed on this sheet; named Moorman from the key map (between Ingleside and Hackberry, sheet 322); the suffix is a guess, check against sheet 322. Hackberry St. enters from the north; McMillan bends to run up-right (NE) at Hackberry (60' printed west of it, 50' east of it), so no separate bend is recorded. Salutaris Avenue becomes Brooklyn at Carondolet (same point recorded under both names, as on sheet 327); wood steps are drawn in the Salutaris/Brooklyn roadway (x~355-395) above and below Carondolet. The unnamed ~12-14 ft strip north of the Carondolet lots (the alley stub on sheet 327) runs from Salutaris to the east lot line at x~2877; width not printed. Rose Alley width (16') is printed only in the inset. Columbia Avenue (60') crosses the lower right diagonally with no junction on the main map; its Brooklyn junction is south of the bottom edge. INSET (thick border, bottom right from x~3750, y~4950-7795) shows a displaced piece: Brooklyn with Rose Alley and Columbia Av. near the Brooklyn/Columbia corner; not recorded (not in the main map frame). Lines at the right edge (sheets 323/324, A-B reference line) are lot lines.
